name: dshd-feedback
description: Deepartments universal feedback store (FeedbackStore + state machine) for the quality department — a pure library package extracted for the dshd-feedback phase of the modular Cordis split. Owns the durable append-only <stateDir>/feedback.jsonl backlog + feedback-archive.jsonl (non-destructive prune). P1 (modularization, 2026-08-29): the package is NOW ALSO a Cordis PLUGIN (thin name/inject/apply + its own cordis.patch.yml row) providing the `deepartments.feedback` service (the opened store) — the bundle still consumes it through the drop-in bridge src/core/feedback.ts (the DECOUPLING hito rewires it to the composed service).
